hints.title: Same-Value Disqualification
hints.text: Any number appearing simultaneously on both sides of the same card can never be hidden.

hints.title: Card Symmetry Freedom
hints.text: Any number not present on both sides of any single card can be flipped face down across all cards.

hints.title: Minimal Eligible Value
hints.text: Record all identical pairs fronts[i] == backs[i] in a forbidden set. The answer is the smallest number across all cards not in the forbidden set, or 0 if none exist.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Set of disallowed duplicate numbers and minimum scan over numbers.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing 2^N flipping states leads to exponential explosion.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash set stores disallowed values in O(N) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Deduce that any number with front != back on every card can always be successfully hidden.
